rounds.response:
Service-Level Commitments During Warehouse Disruptions (per DOC‑SLA‑001 §2.3–2.4):
- Our baseline promise is same‑day shipping for all SKUs and the SLA requires activation of documented contingency fulfillment actions when warehouse capability is impaired
- Contingency playbook priorities include re‑routing/expediting where feasible and prioritizing backlogged orders to restore SLA performance
- Proactive customer communication obligations and the timing/contents of those notifications are specified in §2.4 of DOC‑SLA‑001

Incident Classification & Escalation for Fulfillment Issues (per the Fulfillment Escalation Playbook):
- Incidents are classified by severity per the playbook; P1 (major outage) events trigger immediate escalation to senior operations leadership
- Routine fulfillment incidents are owned by site and regional operations and follow standard remediation workflows
- Per policy, unresolved fulfillment incidents are escalated to senior ops leadership if not resolved within 72 hours, and customer notification requirements follow the incident severity and DOC‑SLA‑001 §2.4 rules
